description:
Pro feature. Assemble a starter project from 3-8 complementary licence-cleared components
    for what you are building: file tree, files with attribution headers, a README listing every
    source and licence, a NOTICE file and install commands. Cost: 10 credits per call (Pro plan;
    other plans get an upgrade message and are not charged).

    Parameters: prompt (required) -- what you are building, e.g. "saas with stripe billing and
    magic-link login". stack -- optional, e.g. "nextjs" or "python fastapi".

    Returns JSON with files, tree, readme, notice, install commands and credits_charged.

    Example: compose_starter(prompt="todo api with jwt auth", stack="python fastapi")
name: compose_starter
title: Compose a starter project (Pro)
